observations.scope: All 541 active references already in the US market before the same-day additions were fetched individually from their official en-US PDPs. observations.method: For 541 current PDPs, recorded exact reference, regional title, displayed USD amount, add-to-cart form presence, and Contact a Boutique action. Reused the 21 same-day individual PDP observations for catalog additions and kept their original source-attempt linkage.
